page.overview:
What is Menaris?

Menaris was the second planet inward of the Canopus system. Because of similarities of size and orbit, Menaris and Extaris were informally referred to as "the Twins." Their combination was responsible for the highly eccentric orbit of the third planet, Arrakis. It iswasmuch larger in radius than Seban.

Because of the above, the planet nearly rolled in its orbit with contrasting seasonal effects, one hemisphere eternally hot and the other eternally cold although the atmosphere mitigates the temperature effects to some extent.

Menaris possessed a dense atmosphere of carbon dioxide with traces of nitrogen dioxide (which was responsible for the yellow brown tint). Largely because of its oxidizing atmosphere, there was no known life on Menaris.
